items.title: Stock Market Today: Dow Rises Nearly 300 Points; Dell Retakes A Breakout Point (Live Coverage)
items.summary: The Dow Jones Industrial Average and other major stock indexes held on to moderate gains Wednesday, even as oil continued to rise.  The Dow industrials rose more than 295 points, or 0.6%, to close a hair below 53,062.  In Wednesday's session, the Dow lagged a 1.1% rebound by the small-cap Russell 2000 index, which had tumbled 3.1% over three days.

items.title: Can CAT Stock Compound Its Way Higher?
items.summary: In the second quarter of 2026, Caterpillar's retail sales to users in power generation surged 72% year-over-year, a pace that looks more like a high-growth tech supplier than a traditional industrial giant. This growth is not from traditional sources but from the immense energy needs of new data centers. Caterpillar is quietly becoming a critical infrastructure provider for cloud computing and generative AI.

items.title: Can CAT's Power & Energy Segment Sustain Its Rapid Growth Momentum?
